item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already shows a wind-down: a relaxation session in the evening and a set bedtime. That's a good structure, but it only works if you honor it. Sleep is when your mind sorts the day, and you've got a lot of reflection on your plate. Don't carry it into bed. Tonight, start your relaxation exercise on time and put the phone down when it ends.
